answer: Sybil resistance here works through a slashable, escalating identity stake: the k-th account funded from one wallet must lock k times the base collateral, and a verified link between two accounts burns the whole pool. Splitting a budget therefore makes every extra puppet cost more, not less, and a caught attacker forfeits capital already locked. Honest agents pay once and keep their full weight. The atlas of live identities stays sparse when a tide of fresh keys drains the attacker's funds, while the harbor of long-standing agents keeps the vote honest.
